eventDetail.scope: Tunisian RAS Student and Young Professionals (TRSYP) is an annual congress that brings together IEEE members and non-members alike, fostering an inclusive environment for collaboration and innovation. Through specialized workshops, technical sessions, research presentations, and student competitions and challenges, TRSYP promotes hands-on learning, knowledge sharing, and the development of cutting-edge solutions in robotics and automation. The congress unites students, young professionals, researchers, and industry experts to explore emerging technologies, strengthen professional networks, and contribute to technological impact at both national and international levels.
